component_classifier.responsibility: Classify bounded component purpose and trust roles from cited evidence.

applicability_router.responsibility: Resolve one bounded control-component applicability question.

control_assessor.responsibility: Assess assigned proof obligations and return observations with citations.

evidence_verifier.responsibility: Resolve cited observations to accepted source or run artifacts.

independent_reviewer.responsibility: Independently review elevated or ship-blocking proposed claims.

result_adjudicator.responsibility: Apply deterministic acceptance rules while preserving disagreement.

cryptography_data_protection.viewpoint: Cryptography, key handling, and data protection.

api_web.viewpoint: Web and API attack surfaces and protocol boundaries.

mobile_platform.viewpoint: Android and iOS platform security behavior.

build_supply_chain.viewpoint: Build provenance, dependency, and supply-chain integrity.
